en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  It is narrated that Imam (a.s.) said, “The Almighty Allah has  promised  two  punishments  for  those  who  usurp  the wealth of orphans forcefully. One of these is the punishment of  hereafter  and  that  is  the  fire  of  Hell.
Another  is  the punishment of this world and Allah says regarding this:

And let those fear  who, should they leave behind  them weakly offspring,  would  fear  on  their  account,  so  let  them  be careful  of  (their  duty  to)  Allah,  and  let  them  speak  right words.
Because your children can be dealt in the similar way as you deal with other orphans.”
